series.title: NGEN puts Croatia’s first standalone, transmission-connected BESS online, with 60MW/120MWh capacity
series.summary: BESS owner-operator NGEN has put its Šibenik project into commercial operation in Croatia, claiming it as the first standalone project to connect at the transmission-level.

series.title: Italy: RWE and BNZ launch construction on large-scale battery projects
series.summary: Power firms RWE and BNZ have both announced construction on large-scale BESS projects in Italy, all-in-all totalling nearly 500MWh of capacity.

series.title: Sumitomo Corporation, Greenvolt deploy BESS at both ends of scale in Japan’s layered market
series.summary: Battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in Japan by Sumitomo Corporation and Greenvolt provide an interesting snapshot of the country’s development landscape.

series.title: Canada: Alectra-Convergent complete 320MWh portfolio in Ontario, Rodan advances country’s largest BTM BESS
series.summary: Alectra Energy Solutions and Convergent Energy & Power have completed a 320MWh BESS portfolio at three sites in Ontario.

series.title: BAAJA: US legislation to speed up permitting carries hidden political risk, ‘won’t solve interconnection queue wait’
series.summary: The energy storage industry is abuzz with discussion of passing BAAJA following Democrats’ taking of the House and Senate in the 2026 US midterm elections.

series.title: GE Vernova to spend $34.5M expanding Louisiana transformer manufacturing capacity
series.summary: “Electricity demand is growing, and transformers are part of the critical grid equipment essential to delivering the power our customers and modern economies depend on,” said the head of the company’s electrification segment.

series.title: 800MWh BESS enters NSW assessment as Recurrent’s 600MWh Sundown project clears Australia’s EPBC Act
series.summary: Delta and partner Samsung Vista C&I Australia have lodged an EIS for an 800MWh BESS at the Vales Point Power Station site in NSW.

series.title: ju:niz Energy enlists Envision for 442MWh grid-forming BESS in Germany
series.summary: Envision Energy will supply its Gen 8 BESS platform for ju:niz Energy's 442MWh Smareg 13 project in Bavaria, Germany.

series.title: RelyEZ debuts on HKEX Main Board, becoming latest Chinese energy storage player to list in Hong Kong
series.summary: RelyEZ has listed on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, becoming the latest Chinese energy storage system solution provider to list in Hong Kong.

series.title: Semi-solid state batteries for BESS: potential and challenges

series.title: California orders utilities to develop joint DER orchestration framework
series.summary: The October order also directed PG&E, SCE and SDG&E to “more explicitly” consider flexible demand, a move one regulator said could reduce interconnection delays.

series.title: Calibrant Energy secures US$145 million for solar and BESS across US power markets including PJM hyperscaler project
series.summary: Calibrant Energy, an energy-as-a-service platform, has closed a US$145 million debt facility for solar and energy storage projects across several US power markets.

series.title: Lydian’s 600MWh Utah BESS reaches commercial operation, supporting Meta data centre
series.summary: Excelsior Energy Capital-backed developer Lydian Energy has brought its 150MW/600MWh Faraday battery energy storage system (BESS) project in Utah County, Utah, US into commercial operation.

series.title: No home left behind: Scaling VPP participation while maintaining customer control
series.summary: Utilities that redesign demand response and virtual power plant programs around how customers actually behave will be the ones to boost participation and system flexibility, writes Uplight’s Gisela Glandt.

series.title: ‘Must be ready and able to deliver’: EnergyAustralia pays AU$750,000 over alleged FCAS failures at four BESS
series.summary: EnergyAustralia has paid AU$750,000 (US$519,300) in penalties after the Australian Energy Regulator (AER) alleged that four battery energy storage systems (BESS) it manages failed to deliver frequency services offered into the market.

series.title: Alinta Energy’s 200MWh Wagerup BESS online in Western Australia after ‘significant redesign’
series.summary: Alinta Energy's 100MW/200MWh BESS at its Wagerup thermal power plant in Western Australia has been operating commercially since September.

series.title: What six months of Dutch market data tell us about the true worth of renewables & BESS dispatch optimisation
series.summary: Analysis of optimiser performance in the Dutch electricity market highlights the need to separate claims and forecasting from realistic outcomes, writes Omer Bumin of trading infrastructure software company Powerlys.

series.title: FlexGen chosen as system integrator for Google-backed US solar-plus-storage project with MN8, Eos
series.summary: Software-focused energy storage system integrator FlexGen will serve as the integrator of MN8 Energy’s solar-plus-storage project in Kanawha, West Virginia, US, using solutions from Eos Energy Enterprises.

series.title: German utility to build 7.5MW/30MWh project using Eos’ zinc-bromide battery tech
series.summary: Stadtwerke Gaggenau, a municipal utility in Germany, has hired a general contractor to build a 4-hour BESS project using the zinc-bromide technology from US firm Eos Energy Enterprises.

series.title: Data centers could lower your electricity bill. Will utilities let them?
series.summary: When sales increase more than costs, rates should decline. But some utilities are using lower historical sales data with updated cost assumptions to try and “lock in” higher rates, writes Edward Burgess of Current Energy Group.

series.title: DC bidirectional charging and data centre demand are reshaping the case for US DERs
series.summary: As data centre demand surges, utilities and developers are turning to distributed energy resources (DERs) to ease grid strain.

series.title: ConEd joins utilities seeking to loosen New York restrictions on owning generation
series.summary: The company says reforms would boost renewables and help it achieve resource adequacy and environmental compliance targets. It has also asked regulators to expand distribution and transmission-connected storage options.

series.title: As coal burn declines, rising power demand will be primarily met by renewables: EIA
series.summary: The electric power sector could install more than 26 GW of battery storage next year, helping support a renewable resource base expected to supply almost a quarter of 2027 consumption, EIA said.

series.title: Türkiye, China sign $15 billion renewables investment plan
series.summary: The deal, signed as COP31 continues, plans to cover 7 GW of solar and wind power plants, energy storage systems and 4 GW of electricity transmission infrastructure. The post Türkiye, China sign $15 billion renewables investment plan appeared first on pv magazine Global .

series.title: Norway enters carbon credit agreement with Indonesia
